lines.zh: 我踏着沉重的步子前进
lines.en: I advance with heavy steps.
Iron and bone creak upon me.

lines.zh: 长枪拄地，我一步一步走
lines.en: Lance planted, I walk step by step.
My steed keeps pace beside me.
Each step sinks the ground.
I patrol the shore, slowly.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，我直接推过去
lines.en: I don't go around. I push through.
Cold air comes off me.
I head toward the lights.
Thin ice forms where I've passed.
I halt and plant my lance in the soil.
I remember my oath.

lines.zh: 可我已经想不起效忠谁
lines.en: But I can no longer recall whom I served.

lines.zh: 我身上没有心跳的声音
lines.en: There's no heartbeat in me.
Water seeps inside my plates.

lines.zh: 我在等一道早已消失的命令
lines.en: I wait for an order long since gone.
Wind crosses my visor; it's cold.

lines.zh: 我的坐骑在旁边安静站着
lines.en: My steed stands quietly nearby.
I raise my head, slowly.
Memory recedes like a falling tide.
I tighten my grip on the shaft.

lines.zh: 这片陆地不是我的战场
lines.en: This land is not my battlefield.

lines.zh: 我听见海在很远的地方响。
lines.en: I hear the sea sounding far away.

lines.zh: 甲壳里没有疲倦，只有冰。
lines.en: No weariness inside this shell — only frost.
I am only waiting for an opponent.

lines.zh: 甲片上的霜又厚了一层
lines.en: The frost on my plates thickens again.
I turn my lance point to the ground.
Standing long, my feet have frozen in.
State your name.
I look down at you without expression.
You carry no weapon.
I raise my lance, then lower it.

lines.zh: 我的枪尖一碰，你就结冰。
lines.en: One touch of my lance and you freeze.
I salute you, slowly.
You stand before me and don't flinch.

lines.zh: 我记不清上次见人是什么时候
lines.en: I can't recall the last time I saw a person.
What would you ask of me?
The ice on me would hurt you.
Three steps back, then we'll talk.
Your courage is worth remembering.
I fall back half a pace; my plates ring.
That didn't pierce my armor.
One of my joints locked.
Frost spills from the breach.
I remain upright.
I raise the lance and realign.
Pain has grown strange to me.
My steed gives a low cry.
This plate is cracked, but it will serve.
My ice plate cracked; I still stand.

lines.zh: 我的剑落下时，你会结冰。
lines.en: When my sword falls, you freeze.
Set it down.

lines.zh: 这具身体早已不吃东西
lines.en: This body stopped eating long ago.
I glance at it with no reaction.
Leave that for the living.
I don't accept alms.
I raise a hand for you to take it back.
I'd forgotten that smell.
You should keep this yourself.
My lance serves me better than food.
You hit my armor. Hard, isn't it?
I step back half a pace to let you pass.
My steed makes way for you.
There's no need for us to clash.
My armor is cold as a block of iron.
That bump barely registered.
You've rubbed the frost off me.
Please pass on my flank.
My lance nearly swept you.
Too close, and the cold will harm you.
I swore an oath: no more of that.
My knight is gone.

lines.zh: 我守着一段早已结束的誓约
lines.en: I keep an oath that ended long ago.
You needn't stay with me.
One such as I should have no companion.
Go. Toward the light.
I'll remember how you looked.
Staying here is enough for me.
This isn't refusal. It's protection.
When the tide falls, I'll go.
I bend and pick it up.
My fingers are stiff with cold.
This is for you.
I plant it in the soil.
Not worth carrying.
I lift it, then set it down.
Frost forms on it in my hand.
This isn't mine.

lines.zh: 我把它推到你脚边，收好。
lines.en: I nudged it to your feet, keep it.
I count them and put them away.
I sense a movement.
I raise my head and fix the direction.
Whatever comes is no small thing.
I grip the lance at its middle.
Cold gathers inside me.
It stands between me and the village.
I take one step forward.
My steed grows restless.
I know this kind of presence.
I won't warn a second time.
A single target.
I raise the lance point.
Let it move first.
I stand firm and let it come.
Every plate on me opens.
From now on, it is an enemy.
Frost climbs the shaft.
Ice on my lance tip.
I hold this distance.
When it nears, the lance goes out.
The cold goes first; the lance follows.
I circle it, moving my feet.
It means to slip around my flank.
My steed blocks the left.
I measure its distance.
The frost on my plates thickens.
It hesitates. That's the moment.
I lower the lance a foot.
It's retreating.
I won't chase beyond this ground.
I stand motionless and let it come.
My breathing has slowed.
I record its every step.
A little closer still.
It's inside my reach now.
Then let it end.
I square the lance.
The final moment is here.
The lance drives straight out.
The point passes through its armor.
Cold creeps into the wound.
It's frozen and cannot move.
I step in and thrust again.
My steed charges in the same breath.
This blow isn't from hatred.
It struggles twice on the ground.
I draw the lance back out.
Frost covers its wound.
I return to my position.
This was only duty.
The ice on my plates cracks.
I raise the lance and wipe it.
I rise out of the frozen earth.
The lance is still in my hand.
My steed waits beside me.

lines.zh: 我记不清自己躺了多久
lines.en: I can't say how long I lay there.

lines.zh: 海的声音比记忆里更近
lines.en: The sea sounds closer than I remember.
My plates settle into place one by one.
Frost spreads from my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看清了这片天
lines.en: I raise my head and take in this sky.
I still remember how to hold a lance.
No order comes; I go on my own.
The grass underfoot freezes white.
I head where people are.
My name has grown indistinct.
But the oath remains.

lines.zh: 我踏出第一步，地面裂了
lines.en: My first step cracks the ground.
Voices seem to come from afar.
I lift the lance toward the sky.
I am still a knight.
Then let the patrol continue.
Then the patrol goes on.

lines.zh: 火烤得甲片发烫，我不退。
lines.en: Fire heats my plates — I don't retreat.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，砸出深坑
lines.en: I fall from a height and crater the ground.
Water closes over my visor.
The blast throws my steed down.
An arrow lodges between my plates.

lines.zh: 这股法术在我体内炸开
lines.en: This spell bursts inside me.

lines.zh: 我早已不需进食，却会枯竭
lines.en: I need no food, yet I still run dry.

lines.zh: 雷劈中长枪，我浑身一颤
lines.en: Lightning strikes the lance; I shudder.

lines.zh: 虚空把我的甲一片片剥走
lines.en: The void strips my plates away one by one.
